page_title: REN 1-0 STR | Rennes v Strasbourg 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
90+2' Here comes a substitution. Arnaud Kalimuendo is given a rest as he is replaced by Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes).
90+1' Stephanie Frappart shows a yellow card to Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) for his blatant foul.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 0 After the corner kick, Ludovic Blas (Rennes) directs his wonderful effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner!
89' The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
89' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. The referee points to the corner flag and Rennes will take a corner.
86' The game is interrupted as Adrien Truffert (Rennes) is flagged offside.
85' Jordan James (Rennes) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
85' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Stephanie Frappart had an easy-decision to make.
83' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle after Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
81' Liam Rosenior decides to make a substitution. Felix Lemarechal will be replaced by Sekou Mara (Strasbourg).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Abdoul Ouattara leaves the pitch and Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) comes on.
80' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but Brice Samba comes off his line to gather the ball.

78' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
77' Naouirou Ahamada (Rennes) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
75' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
73' The corner is swung in but Strasbourg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
71' Brice Samba (Rennes) receives a yellow card.
71' Unsporting behaviour by Brice Samba (Rennes).
69' Jordan James (Rennes) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
67' Rough tackle by Naouirou Ahamada (Rennes). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Here is a change. Lilian Brassier is going off and Jorge Sampaoli gives the last tactical orders to Mikayil Faye (Rennes).
66' Substitution. Mohamed Meite (Rennes) on for Kyogo Furuhashi.
65' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) makes a strong challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul.
63' Strasbourg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
59' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

58' This was a piece of cake for Brice Samba. Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
56' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
55' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Djaoui Cisse as he is replaced by Naouirou Ahamada (Rennes).
53' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

52' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball is out of play and Strasbourg manage to earn a corner.
49' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Strasbourg.
46' Lilian Brassier (Rennes) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
46' Referee Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
44' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
43' That was close by Kyogo Furuhashi (Rennes)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
42' Kyogo Furuhashi (Rennes) is caught offside!
41' Jordan James (Rennes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
40' Jordan James (Rennes) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
40' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
36' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
34' The resulting corner from Jordan James (Rennes) comes to nothing.
32' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stephanie Frappart no option but to blow his whistle.
31' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
28' Great teamplay by Rennes as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
26' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
22' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
19' Lilian Brassier (Rennes) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
17' The foul by Kyogo Furuhashi (Rennes) was seen by Stephanie Frappart who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
15' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
14' A quickly taken corner by Rennes.

14' Lilian Brassier (Rennes) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
10' Rennes keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
7' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
7' A player from Rennes takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Strasbourg are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

4' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
4' Jordan James (Rennes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

4' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
3' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
1' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Djordje Petrovic, who makes a comfortable save.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Rennes will have the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart is the one to supervise the game today.
